original_test_intent: Physically connect the designated SUT serial port to a client and demonstrate reproducible bidirectional communication with an approved harmless payload.

original_procedure_criteria.procedure: Plug the cable between serial port and client, establish the connection, and enter a useful command.

historical_reviews.deepseek: NO because the agent cannot wire or observe the serial terminal.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: BLOCKED due to missing electrical mapping, settings, payload, expected response and recovery.
historical_reviews.v3: RECLASSIFIED to MANUAL ONLY; missing settings are execution inputs rather than a permanent automation blocker.

v3_1_conclusion.manual_test_activity: Engineer identifies and connects the physical serial path, operates or observes the terminal, and supplies the formal communication result. Agent may organize a terminal transcript supplied through an approved capture channel.
required_user_inputs: Client/server role, harmless payload, expected reply and timeout

master_vs_project_parameters.master_default: Physical serial connection and an unspecified useful command; 10/0-minute planning values.
master_vs_project_parameters.project_inputs: Bind exact ports, electrical settings, payload, response and timeout for the platform.
master_vs_project_parameters.coverage_difference: A remote OS console or Redfish check would not cover the physical serial path named by the master.

original_method: Physical serial cable plus client terminal. Preserve it because the access path is the function under test.

modernized_recommendation.reason: A serial-console server may help capture the transcript only if it terminates the same qualified electrical path; SSH or Redfish would change coverage.

safety_boundaries: Do not connect an unknown RS-232/RS-422/RS-485 path.
Do not send arbitrary commands to an unidentified console.
Maintain alternate OOB access and restore the original cable state.
expected_evidence: Timestamped two-way terminal transcript with exact payload and reply
no_automatic_retry: Framing errors, unexpected peer response or console loss are preserved. Do not vary electrical settings or retry another payload without engineer approval.
engineer_owned_verdict: The engineer evaluates the transcript and physical connection; the agent cannot declare the serial communication testcase PASS.
review_improvement: KEEP because V3 correctly distinguishes a clear manual communication intent from an irreducible blocker and prevents substitution of another access path. V3.1 adds explicit project binding and no-retry behavior without changing the classification.
